text_block_list.text:
My! That means
we've received high praise...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"However, the path to 'that place' has only just begun.
Let us continue to fulfill our duties as the Saint."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, your dedication is genuine. That mindset...
I hope you never lose sight of it."
Using this momentum, I want to make the next season just as fulfilling. Let's decide on our next training policy based on the growth we've made so far.
